description.text: The fourth expansion of the XY series, released on 13 September 2014, with Mega Gengar on the wrapper. It centers on Psychic-type Pokémon led by Gengar-EX and M Gengar-EX. M Manectric-EX came with Manectric Spirit Link, one of the first Spirit Link cards: a Pokémon Tool that lets a Pokémon Mega Evolve without ending the turn. Team Flare's Gear and Hyper Gear Items arrived, such as Jamming Net, which is attached to the opponent's Pokémon-EX, along with Lysandre's Trump Card, which shuffles both players' discard piles back into their decks and was banned from official play less than a year later. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 88, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-EX and Supporters and Ultra Rare M Manectric-EX and M Gengar-EX. In English most of its cards came out in Phantom Forces in November 2014.
